title: Pear Point Open Cuff
descriptionHtml:
Two points of light, facing each other. A slim polished open cuff that tapers to its two ends, each finished with one pear cut clear stone in a claw setting. The two pears face each other across the opening, right where the wrist turns.

STYLING TIP: Wear it with the opening on top of the wrist so both pears show.

Details

  • Style: Slim open cuff
  • Band: Polished, approximately 4mm, tapering to the ends
  • Stones: One pear cut clear cubic zirconia, approximately 7mm, at each end
  • Inner width: Approximately 6cm
  • Plating: 18k gold tone plated
  • Material: Surgical stainless steel

Care

Waterproof and tarnish free, so daily wear and water are fine. Keep it away from perfume and harsh chemicals, wipe with a soft dry cloth and store it flat in its pouch.

You will receive your piece in a Naira Petite box.
